title: AsymSpec: Context-Asymmetric Speculative Decoding for Agentic LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.26004v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic LLM pipelines face escalating inference costs as context accumulates across retrieval, tool use, and multi-turn interactions. To control latency, deployments routinely compress inputs, but this degrades task accuracy. Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates generation losslessly, yet it assumes the drafter and verifier share an identical context, preventing SD from resolving the accuracy-overhead trade-off. We propose AsymSpec, an asymmetric speculative decoding framework that breaks this symmetry: a lightweight drafter reads the full input while the large verifier operates on the compressed view. The drafter steers the verifier via a contrastive $\delta$-fusion of logits, modulated by a divergence-aware acceptance gate that preserves verification stability and high draft acceptance rates. Evaluated across four agentic capabilities and two end-to-end agent benchmarks, AsymSpec reaches $\approx 90\%$ of full-context accuracy on av

translated_title: AsymSpec：面向智能体大语言模型的上下文非对称投机解码
translated_abstract: 智能体大语言模型流水线在检索、工具使用和多轮交互过程中，随着上下文累积，推理成本不断上升。为控制延迟，部署时通常会对输入进行压缩，但这会降低任务准确性。投机解码（SD）能无损地加速生成，但其假设草稿模型和验证模型共享相同的上下文，因此无法解决准确性与开销之间的权衡问题。我们提出AsymSpec，一种非对称投机解码框架，打破了这一对称性：轻量级草稿模型读取完整输入，而大型验证模型在压缩视图上运行。草稿模型通过对比性δ-逻辑融合来引导验证模型，并由一个发散感知的接受门控调节，以保持验证稳定性和高草稿接受率。在四种智能体能力和两个端到端智能体基准上的评估表明，AsymSpec在压缩设置下能达到约90%的全上下文准确率。
tldr: 提出AsymSpec框架，通过让轻量草稿模型读取完整输入、大型验证模型处理压缩上下文，利用对比性δ融合和发散感知门控，在保持高准确率的同时大幅降低推理开销。
en_tdlr: AsymSpec proposes an asymmetric speculative decoding framework where a lightweight drafter reads full context and a large verifier operates on compressed input, using contrastive delta-fusion and divergence-aware gating to achieve ~90% full-context accuracy with reduced inference cost.
